adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, deduplication is done in application code by reading `booking.attendees` and filtering with a case-sensitive comparison (`guest === attendee.email`) before `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`. There is no normalization (e.g., lowercasing) and no transactional/atomic guard, so concurrent requests can both pass the check and attempt to insert the same email, and mixed-case variants like `User@x.com` vs `user@x.com` are treated as different. The diff also shows `createMany` without `skipDuplicates`, so the code itself does not prevent duplicates (or prevents them only if an unseen DB constraint exists).
